setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): First set really gets cooking around Scarlet Begonias and keeps going [19]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Help on the Way, Slipknot!, Franklin's Tower sequence very mellow [8]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Reviewer describes the Slipknot! and following Franklin's Tower as overwhelming and joyful [15]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Wharf Rat as a favorite, along with Slipknot! and Dancin' in the Streets [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-21.mtx.seamons.121045.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112191.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 178 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has crystal clear sound with a smooth, liquid 1976 feel [19]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112171.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 179 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [5]
- **gd76-06-21.aud.vernon.6679.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 163 min; rated 3.18/5 by 11 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this audience recording's sound quality very poor and wants a better copy circulated; Somewhat muddy next to soundboards or high-quality audience tapes, typical of audience recordings from the 1976-78 period; Reviewer considers it a decent recording given the circumstances in which tapers worked at the time [8][10][11][12][16]

## Around the show

- Tapers then lacked the band's approval, hid equipment on entry, and quickly lowered mic stands when house lights came up [11]
- Reviewer argues tapers were always welcomed; taper sections arose from seating and setup conflicts between tapers and other audience members [13]
- Reviewer says taping was discouraged early on, with equipment confiscated or destroyed, citing another recording where the band joked about spotlighting a taper [14]
- Audience members repeatedly yelled for China Cat between Looks Like Rain and Scarlet Begonias [15]
- One audience member yelled for China Cat after every song [17]
- Opens a strong run of Tower shows; reviewer says the next night gets even better [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-21.mtx.seamons.121045.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Jubal H. Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) [1]. Also: Chain: soundboard to master cassette, Apogee Ensemble, Peak, AIFF, Samplitude Professional 11.1, then FLAC [1]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112191.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF [4]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112171.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF [5]. Also: Tapes supplied and digitized by Digitalrbb; Joe B. Jones helped pitch-correct the patch source; Disc changes are seamless in this soundboard transfer [5]
- **gd76-06-21.aud.vernon.6679.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Shure [7]. Also: Released as filler on Download Series Vol. 4, so even audience portions of this show are available [16]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by SoundCloud: [Franklin's Tower (Live at Tower Theater, Philadelphia, PA, 6/21/1976)](https://soundcloud.com/gratefuldead/sets/franklins-tower-live-at-tower) [21]
- Fan art by gd.lnk.to: [Grateful Dead - Franklin's Tower (Live at Tower Theater, Philadelphia, PA, 6/21/1976)](https://gd.lnk.to/FTLive) [22]
